saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Βιτάλιος που μαρτύρησε στη Ραβέννα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and «Αγιος Βιταλιος Που Μαρτυρησε Στη Ραβεννα (; - 62)». The man is the folder's own, the Vitalis of Ravenna stoned in a pit, and he is none of the corpus's other three — Vitalis, Vitalis of Sicily and Vitalius of Corfu — who are other men on other days. The Greek page gives the year the Romanian source did not and it is taken into `dates`; it also gives his trade, armourer, the name of the physician Ursicinus whom he encouraged at his torture, the judge Paulinus who had him seized, and the idol-priest who threw stones at him and was then seized by a demon and drowned in the nearby river. The corpus keeps `valeria-the-martyr-23-july` on the same menologion day from the Romanian calendar, and this Greek page does not name her, so she gets no Greek row from this reading. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Βιταλιος Που Μαρτυρησε Στη Ραβεννα (; - 62)», the year of birth left as a question mark, and its first sentence repeats it: «Ο Άγιος Βιτάλιος μαρτύρησε το έτος 62 μ.Χ.» The Romanian source the folder was built from gave no year.
